what_this_measures: Exact agreement between the memo and the structured sections of the same report. Where they disagree the memo is wrong by construction: the section is the source and the memo is the retelling. Does NOT evaluate whether the memo's free prose is entailed by retrieved evidence -- that needs atomic claim decomposition and an entailment model (FActScore/ALCE).
